videos.title: When brain injuries make you unrecognisable: how Phineas Gage helped scientists understand trauma
videos.author: The Royal Institution
videos.description:
Severe brain injury can affect an individual to the point where their loved ones don't recognise them 🧠 Have you known someone with a traumatic brain injury?

In the full talk, Ariel Zeleznikow-Johnston highlights the ethical considerations of this when looking at the science of brain preservation.
